resources.string:
AstroClock measures time by astronomical standards.
The inner circle shows the position of the sun during a day and the moments of sunrise and sunset.
The middle circle shows the phase of the moon.
The outer circle shows the position of the earth in its orbit around the sun.

In pointer rotation mode the pointers rotate in clockwise direction.
In ring rotation mode the rings rotate (at different speeds) in counter clockwise direction.

Click on the widget to view statistics and edit settings.
To install the AstroClock widget on your home screen, long press the home screen, then select widgets, then select AstroClock.\nThe AstroClock widget requires a two by two empty icon space.
